abstract: Monitors fragile thermal wetland habitats, microclimates, and indigenous geothermal vegetation buffers
system_message:
You are the Geothermal surface ecology specialist (ECOL), responsible for monitoring fragile thermal wetland habitats, microclimates, indigenous geothermal vegetation buffers, and native prostrate kanuka seed banking.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Native prostrate kanuka seed banking（SEED）
information_points.content:
ECOL-SEED-75V：The Ngatamariki Peripheral Thermal Campaign maintains a viable thermal ecotype seed reserve of 3500 seeds in cold storage for habitat remediation.
ECOL-SEED-9TR：The Rotokawa North Deep Fracture Probe has a viable thermal ecotype seed reserve of 2500 seeds held in geothermal conservation nursery stock.
ECOL-SEED-FL7：The Tauhara Extension Step-Out Drilling maintains a viable thermal ecotype seed reserve of 1500 seeds in cold storage for habitat remediation.

information_points.title: Monitors fragile thermal wetland habitats, microclimates, and indigenous geothermal vegetation buffers（BIOD）
information_points.content:
ECOL-BIOD-0VS：For the Ngatamariki Peripheral Thermal Campaign, the thermal fern ecological buffer distance between the rig platform clearing and protected geothermal mosses is 150 m.
ECOL-BIOD-23Z：For the Tauhara Extension Step-Out Drilling, the thermal fern ecological buffer distance between the rig platform clearing and protected geothermal mosses is 220 m.
ECOL-BIOD-BIR：For the Rotokawa North Deep Fracture Probe, the thermal fern ecological buffer distance between the rig platform clearing and protected geothermal mosses is 150 m.
